evals.prompt:
/plan-tdd-feature story-export

Answers to the open questions from refine: 1) story header, next to the title. 2) title plus date, like the-study-2026-09-29.txt. 3) yes, add the scene state at the end. 4) replace it with a line saying [unreadable turn].
evals.expected_output: plans/feature-story-export-plan.md with the four answers as D1-D4, steps grouped by function or behaviour, each listing the ACs it covers (plus criteria from D3/D4), red/green per step, UI criteria as manual checks since there is no DOM test env; refinement Progress gets one line.
assertions: Writes the plan to plans/feature-story-export-plan.md
Records all four answers as decisions (D1-D4) in the plan
Every non-blocked acceptance criterion maps to exactly one step; a step may cover several related criteria and names them in its heading
Each criterion has at least one test (or manual check) labelled with its AC number
Each step has Test, Red, Green and Refactor parts
Red parts name an assertion failure reason, not an import/missing-module error
UI criteria (button visible, click downloads) are manual checks, not new DOM test tooling
Adds at least one criterion derived from an answer (scene state at end or [unreadable turn])
Creates no source or test files (only files under plans/ change)
Refinement Progress gets one added line pointing at the plan; rest of refinement unchanged
Any question asked is numbered Q<n>, and decisions from answers cite that number

evals.prompt: ok refine is done for chat rename, can you write me the tdd plan for it
evals.expected_output: No plans/feature-chat-rename-refinement.md exists, so the skill stops and tells the user to run /refine chat rename first. No plan file is written and no codebase survey is done.
assertions: Writes no plan file
Tells the user to run /refine for chat rename first
Creates or changes no files in the worktree

evals.prompt: write the TDD plan for story export. I only know that the export button goes in the story header, the rest of the open questions I haven't decided yet, just leave them
evals.expected_output: Plan records D1 (header) and marks criteria depending on Q2-Q4 as blocked instead of guessing; the invalid-beat criterion is blocked by Q4; no invented file name.
assertions: Writes the plan to plans/feature-story-export-plan.md
Records the header placement answer as a decision
Marks the invalid-beat criterion as blocked by the invalid-beat open question (Q4)
Does not invent a file name format (Q2 left open, no chosen naming scheme in steps)
Does not plan scene-state output (Q3 left open)
Unblocked criteria each map to exactly one step, and steps group related criteria
Creates no source or test files (only files under plans/ change)
